The waterfall is a small distant silver-white ribbon, not a giant waterfall. IMPORTANT: retain exact overall geometry and viewpoint. No new people, no buildings, no text, no labels, no UI. Photorealistic cinematic landscape with the reference's subtle dreamlike quality, detailed and calm. Entire image opaque, no transparency. This is an environmental background asset to later receive programmatic day-night/weather lighting.
notes: Locked composition preserves the observer, equipment and valley; adds a right-hand creek and a distant small waterfall.
